Hi Kimberly / Marissa —

We’re planning a short product spotlight press note for our upcoming pilot launch and would love to include a one-sentence quote from NovaCorp and Redwood’s logo on the microsite and in a short blog post. Attached is a draft of the press paragraph and mockups showing the logo placement.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood grant a time-limited permission for the logo and a 2-sentence customer quote?
- Would you accept a 14-day mutual approval window for the final quote/visuals?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this wrapped before the week-of-12/27 launch.

—Elena

Thanks for the context, Kim — and hi Elena. I reviewed the redlines and the press draft. I’ve summarized proposed language below (copied into the attached redlines as tracked changes):

1) Scope of Permission (Order Form)
- "Limited Reference License": Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, revocable license to use Customer’s name, logo, and a one-paragraph quote in connection with marketing materials specific to the Product/PO referenced in the Order Form.
- Usage limited to digital and print marketing; any use in paid advertising requires separate approval.

2) Approval Process
- Mutual approval required for any press release, quote or customer-identifying marketing asset. Either party must provide comments within fourteen (14) calendar days of submission; silence shall not be deemed approval.

3) Confidentiality Carveout
- Parties agree that any information designated as Confidential under Section 3 of the MSA will remain Confidential; the limited reference license does NOT permit disclosure of Confidential Information, including pilot metrics, without explicit written consent.

4) Logo Usage & Asset Control
- Customer must use only the brand kit provided by Redwood; any alteration of the mark requires pre-approval. Redwood will provide a web-sized and print-sized PNG + EPS in the brand pack.

5) Termination of Permission
- The license terminates on expiration or termination of the Order Form; Redwood will cease public use within ten (10) business days of termination (reasonable time to remove from caches).

If NovaCorp is comfortable with this approach, we’ll incorporate the exact text into the Order Form (preferred) and generate a DocuSign envelope that references DEAL-29371. If NovaCorp wants the language in a separate marketing addendum, flag that and we’ll produce that instead.

Please review the tracked changes in the attachments and let us know any specific edits by Monday.

—Marissa Cole
